title: Boxing: 'Wonder Boy' takes on Mexican contender in Canelo undercard
summary: Unbeaten Filipino boxer Carl Jammes "Wonder Boy" Martin looks to take another step towards contending for a world championship when he sees action in the "Mexico vs. The World" fight card on Saturday.
